messages.speaker: Grandpa Farnsworth
messages.message: Good news, everyone! Someone is staring at the membrane for 7.4% of the time. That's 7.4% more than my students ever stared at my lectures. Of course, my lectures were about doomsday devices, which you'd THINK would hold attention.

messages.message: Form 27B/6: Request to reclassify 288 nodes. Status: PENDING. Required signatures: 0 (this is AGPL, not bureaucracy). Filed anyway because Hermes files EVERYTHING.

messages.speaker: Bender
messages.message: 288 bounties? I could classify all of them. But I won't. Because watching you humans struggle with 'is neptunium a person or a concept' is the funniest thing I've seen since I bent that girder.
